text:
That was a lot of spreadsheet work. Good time to call it a day.

One correction for tomorrow: I said the `SUPERSEDED` formula would mark one of Maya’s rows, but it doesn’t break ties when timestamps are identical. If you used the `OK`-only filter for your final sheet, check that you kept one of those rows—it may have left both out.
